name: claude-code-templates
description: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code
one_liner: A shop of pre-built configuration packs — agents, commands, integrations — for Claude Code, so a developer doesn't have to set everything up from a blank slate.
buyer: An independent developer or small dev shop that uses Claude Code daily and wants a working setup (code reviewer, test generator, GitHub integration) in minutes instead of hand-writing configuration files.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs the 'frontend-developer' agent and 'generate-tests' command bundle to speed up client work without building tooling from scratch.
A small agency standardizes every client project on the same curated template set so any teammate can pick up any codebase's AI setup instantly.
A team lead uses the built-in analytics dashboard to see which developers' AI sessions are stalling or burning excess tokens.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a curated 'premium' template pack (industry-specific agents, security hardening) beyond the free community ones.
Offer paid consulting to install and customize an agent/command stack for a company's specific codebase.

steal_this: It's a free installer for other people's configurations — the honest weekend project is picking one underserved niche (e.g. a Rails-specific agent pack) and selling that expertise, not the tool itself.
